accounting.baseline_gap: Native SPB-tree/B+tree/SFC implementation is not present/admitted. Pivot columns are not called SPB-tree. Native GTS update timing,AV-tree and RECAST execution also remain unmeasured.
accounting.excluded: Input parse/preparation,all-pair correctness oracle,diagnostic certificate recheck and offline analysis are separately outside method work. No GPU,service-tail,production-RSS or full-program speedup claim.
accounting.output: Every query-ordinal,source-ID,integer-score triple byte-equal to exhaustive reference;all duplicates/live IDs retained.
accounting.ownership: Dense rows,sidecar owner tags and slot maps checked;all existing certificate entries rederived independently for diagnosis and counted separately,not relabeled as zero-cost maintenance.
accounting.row_movement_scope: Dense slots contain immutable authority IDs;sidecar owner/value relocations are executed,but raw string-payload copying is symbolic and not timed. No full native physical-update ACK claim.
separate: per-radius query metric/bound/candidate/frontier work and compute+materialize time

closed_direction: Do not run or tune query-ball/annulus/shared-frontier functions. Reuse only earlier metric,GTS cached snapshot and Quickjoin helpers.

decision.BASELINE_SUFFICIENT_FOR_VALIDITY: All complete outputs/certificates correct;all unchanged surviving pair certificates retained,0 old-pair metric recomputation,0 delete metric calls and exactly128 insert calls. This rejects the global-invalidation premise,not all utility/latency opportunities.
decision.INVALID: First source/input/quality/resource failure stops;retain all files,no automatic retry.
decision.UNCLASSIFIED_STOP: Any other valid result;do not implement a new mechanism or CUDA automatically.
decision.novelty: NOT_ADMITTED in every outcome;ordinary pivot caching/owner tags cannot qualify as a distinct mechanism.
decision.performance_admission: NOT_EVALUATED:no candidate or native SPB admitted. No5x/10x pass can be claimed against weak recompute-all or snapshot-only timings. Future full Gate0 must fix5x minimum/10x strong metric vs strongest admitted controls and charge complete lifecycle before population.

hypotheses.negative: Unchanged object/pivot pairs retain exact distances;delete/swap only changes live ownership;insert computes only new object-pivot distances.
hypotheses.positive: There exists a concrete certificate dependency that ordinary incremental metadata cannot preserve without global recomputation.
hypotheses.utility: Validity does not imply useful pruning;exact query work and complete outputs are independently measured.

methods.GTS_CACHED_SNAPSHOT_CPU: Parent CPU cached-parent GTS replay on separately rebuilt snapshot;NOT native original-GTS update ACK behavior.
methods.PIVOT_INCREMENTAL_CPU: Ordinary4-column triangle bound scan;cache follows immutable owner on swap. Delete computes0 metric distances;insert computes32*4. Query pays64*4 query-pivot distances,all scalar bound comparisons,exact survivor verification,sort and full output.
methods.PIVOT_RECOMPUTE_ALL_WEAK: Same exact queries/cache,unnecessary recomputation after each update. Weak diagnostic only,excluded from research admission.
methods.QUICKJOIN_FAMILY_CPU: Parent exact rectangular Quickjoin family replay;partition work fully charged;not original executable.

question: Do fixed-metric immutable-object insert/delete updates require invalidating all existing point-pivot certificates,or is ordinary owner-preserving local maintenance sufficient?

scope.metric: Exact byte-wise unit Levenshtein;DNA is real GRCh38-derived108bp windows,not original GTS DNA.
scope.radius_rule: For each dataset,nearest-rank quantiles ceil(alpha*32*4096) of calibration-to-initial distances. Freeze all3 resulting integer radii before any evaluation query. Inclusive ties retained;report achieved rates,no radius adjustment,do not deduplicate repeated radii.
scope.sampling: Uniform4096 without replacement from parent initial65536 rows,sorted;reuse32 parent reserved incoming rows. Calibration/evaluation IDs disjoint and exclude both parent query sets. Pivots exclude calibration/evaluation.
scope.source_seed: Random(seed) per dataset;query/calibration/pivot/delete identities generated without reading distances.
scope.updates: Three visible states:initial;delete32 including all4 pivot members plus28 seeded nonquery IDs via dense swap-delete;append32 pre-reserved fresh occurrences. Pivots are retained immutable values independent of live membership.

stage: Semantic/cost premise falsification before mechanism admission;not a full strong-baseline performance Gate0
